nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor and compared against msg.sender by onlyOwner.
Claimable.pendingOwner: address awaiting claim of ownership.
SelectorBasedAccessManager.target: immutable call target of all forwarded transactions.
permissions mapping(address => mapping(bytes4 => bool)) controlling selector-level access.
LoopringIOExchangeOwner.open: global flag that bypasses submitBlocks permission checks.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner ownership handover to newOwner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner renounces ownership to address(0).
Claimable.transferOwnership override: onlyOwner sets pendingOwner.
Claimable.claimOwnership: onlyPendingOwner finalizes ownership transfer.
msg.sender: external caller used for authorization and fund flows.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for expiry and deposit/forced-withdrawal timers.
tx.origin: never referenced in this code; tracked for complete taint enumeration.
Drainable.drain: sends ETH or ERC20 to `to` after canDrain(msg.sender) check.
AddressUtil.sendETH: low-level recipient.call{value: amount, gas: gasLimit} forwarding arbitrary gas.
SelectorBasedAccessManager.transact: guarded arbitrary call to target with msg.value.
target.call{value: msg.value}(data): external call to immutable target with user-supplied calldata.
SelectorBasedAccessManager.fallback: forwards msg.data to transact.
SelectorBasedAccessManager.grantAccess: onlyOwner grants/revokes selector permissions.
hasAccessTo: authorization predicate (user == owner || permissions[user][selector]).
LoopringIOExchangeOwner.canDrain: authorization predicate for drain.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks: decodes blocks, runs callbacks, then fastCallAndVerify to exchange.
AddressUtil.fastCallAndVerify: assembly-level call to target with gasleft() and revert bubbling.
ExchangeWithdrawals.forceWithdraw: payable request storing timestamp and refunding ETH surplus.
ExchangeWithdrawals.transferTokens (private): calls depositContract.withdraw inside try/catch.
ExchangeWithdrawals.distributeWithdrawal: attempts token transfer and credits amountWithdrawable on failure.
ExchangeWithdrawals.withdrawFromDepositRequest: time-gated refund of unprocessed deposit.
S.depositContract.withdraw{gas: gasLimit}(...): external try/catch call to a user-configurable deposit contract.
ERC20SafeTransfer.safeTransferWithGasLimit: builds transfer calldata and calls the token.
token.call{gas: gasLimit}(callData): low-level ERC20 transfer/transferFrom with gas cap.
BytesUtil.fastSHA256: staticcall to the SHA256 precompile with gas() - 2000.
blockchain staticcall to precompile 0x2 for hashing user data.
SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature: validates wallet signatures via staticcall.
signer.staticcall(callData): external static call to arbitrary signer contract.
ZeroDecompressor.decompress: assembly routine reading raw calldata and writing uncompressed bytes.
calldataload(pos)/calldatacopy(ptr, add(32,pos), numDataBytes): unchecked raw calldata reads and memory writes.
LoopringIOExchangeOwner._processTxCallbacks: iterates tx callbacks and invokes receivers.
IBlockReceiver(receivers[idx]).beforeBlockSubmission(txsData, data): external callback to a receiver contract.
LoopringIOExchangeOwner._beforeBlockSubmission: orders block callbacks and cross-checks auxiliary approval data.
AddressUtil.sendETHAndVerify: wraps sendETH and requires success.
newOwner: destination of ownership handover in transferOwnership.
owner: expected account owner of a forced withdrawal request.
token: token address being force-withdrawn.
accountID: offchain account identifier used to index forced withdrawals.
user: address whose permission is granted or queried.
selector: function selector the permission applies to.
granted: boolean permission value applied to permissions[user][selector].
data: calldata forwarded verbatim to the target contract.
drainer: address checked against hasAccessTo before draining funds.
to: recipient address of the low-level value call.
amount: wei value sent by the low-level call.
gasLimit: gas forwarded to the external value call.
recipient: address payable derived from `to` in sendETH.
success: boolean result of the low-level call.
decompressed: calldata-derived bytes fed into fastCallAndVerify.
preApprovedTxs: nested bool array tracking approved transactions per block.
amount: deposit amount captured before deleting the pending deposit.

edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
Claimable.transferOwnership override is gated by onlyOwner.
claimOwnership is gated by onlyPendingOwner comparing msg.sender to pendingOwner.
grantAccess is onlyOwner; caller controls permission grants.
hasAccessTo returns true when user == owner or the permission bit is set.
canDrain delegates to hasAccessTo(drainer, drain.selector).
drain requires canDrain(msg.sender, token) before moving funds.
transact is protected by withAccess(data.toBytes4(0)) keyed on msg.sender.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks requires hasAccessTo(msg.sender, SUBMITBLOCKS_SELECTOR) or open.
msg.sender receives the ETH surplus through sendETHAndVerify during forceWithdraw.
block.timestamp is stored as the forced-withdrawal timestamp used for later timeout logic.
withdrawFromDepositRequest compares block.timestamp against deposit.timestamp + maxAgeDepositUntilWithdrawable.
transferTokens records block.timestamp in protocolFeeLastWithdrawnTime.
transferOwnership writes the privileged owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets owner to address(0).
claimOwnership promotes pendingOwner into owner.
Claimable.transferOwnership stores the pending owner.
claimOwnership clears pendingOwner after promotion.
The open flag short-circuits the permission requirement in submitBlocksWithCallbacks.
permissions[user][selector] is the lookup backing hasAccessTo.
withAccess modifier calls hasAccessTo and reverts with PERMISSION_DENIED.
transact performs an external call to the target with user-supplied calldata and value.
The forwarded calldata and msg.value are delivered to the immutable target contract.
drain sends the contract ETH balance via sendETH (low-level call).
drain moves ERC20 balances through safeTransferAndVerify -> safeTransferWithGasLimit.
safeTransferWithGasLimit issues a low-level call to an arbitrary token address.
distributeWithdrawal attempts the transfer through transferTokens with a caller-supplied gas limit.
withdrawFromDepositRequest refunds the deposit via transferTokens.
transferTokens performs an external gas-capped withdraw call on the deposit contract inside try/catch.
forceWithdraw refunds surplus ETH via sendETHAndVerify.
sendETHAndVerify wraps sendETH and reverts when the value call fails.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks forwards decompressed data to the exchange via fastCallAndVerify.
ZeroDecompressor.decompress consumes the calldata-provided `data` argument.
decompress reads offsets and copies bytes with raw assembly calldataload/calldatacopy.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks invokes _beforeBlockSubmission before the exchange call.
_beforeBlockSubmission drives _processTxCallbacks for each block callback.
_processTxCallbacks makes an external callback to the configured receiver contract.
Receiver callback executes arbitrary code before the target exchange call, allowing reentrant state reads/writes.
verifyERC1271Signature performs an external staticcall to the signer contract.
fastSHA256 staticcalls the SHA256 precompile to hash user data.
newOwner parameter is validated against address(0) and stored as owner.
owner parameter is recorded in pendingForcedWithdrawals for later owner matching.
token parameter is resolved to a tokenID that indexes the forced-withdrawal slot.
accountID parameter is bounds-checked against MAX_NUM_ACCOUNTS and used as a storage key.
user parameter becomes the key of the permissions mapping.
selector parameter becomes the inner key of the permissions mapping.
granted parameter sets the permission bit value.
data parameter determines which selector is permission-checked and what is forwarded.
drainer parameter is checked by hasAccessTo against owner and permissions.
to parameter is the recipient of the low-level value call.
amount parameter is the wei value forwarded to the recipient.
gasLimit parameter determines how much gas the recipient receives.
recipient local is the payable form of `to` used in the call.
success local captures the outcome of the low-level call.
decompressed local bytes are passed to fastCallAndVerify.
preApprovedTxs local array is cross-checked against the block auxiliary data.
amount local is captured from the deposit before the deposit entry is deleted.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner only exists as the ownership target inside transferOwnership and carries its access-control semantics.
owner is a plain argument of forceWithdraw and has no independent identity.
token is only used to derive the tokenID slot inside forceWithdraw.
accountID is a scalar argument of forceWithdraw used as a storage index.
user is only meaningful as the key of the permissions mapping written by grantAccess.
selector is only meaningful as the inner key of the permissions mapping.
granted is a temporary boolean written into permissions and emitted.
data is the forwarded calldata of transact and must be merged into it to keep taint on the call.
drainer is the subject of the canDrain authorization predicate.
to is the call target of the low-level value transfer in sendETH.
amount is the value field of the low-level call in sendETH.
gasLimit is the gas field of the low-level call in sendETH.
recipient is a short-lived payable alias of the call target.
success only records the boolean outcome of the low-level call.
decompressed is the buffer handed to the forwarded exchange call.
preApprovedTxs is a scratch structure used only during callback pre-approval bookkeeping.
amount is a temporary copy of the deposit value inside withdrawFromDepositRequest.
